title: Find the missing hypothesis in Fatou
promptMarkdown: On $(0,1)$ let $g_n=-n1_{(0,1/n)}$. Show that Fatou’s conclusion fails if its nonnegativity hypothesis is simply dropped. Prove the repaired statement for measurable $g_n\ge h$ where $h$ is a fixed integrable function.
hintLadder: Compute the pointwise limit and each integral separately.
Subtract the same integrable lower bound from every term.
